name: Acme editor blog posts and tutorials

mentions.name: Acme editor blog posts and tutorials
mentions.description: A project organizing the author's knowledge of the Acme text editor—hundreds of notes plus dozens of recorded bugs and inconsistencies gathered over two years of use—into blog posts and possibly video tutorials, aiming to document a tool the author considers underrated and thinly covered.
mentions.problem: Acme is underrated in its domain (a tool for experts) and its coverage/documentation is minuscule.
mentions.audience: Programmers and experts who use or might use the Acme text editor
mentions.source_excerpt:
Acme [1], a text editor for programmers. It’s a very unusual tool and I have collected hundreds of notes (as well as dozens of bugs and inconsistencies) from the past two years of using it. Now I feel fully assimilated, I do not take as much notes and it feels the right time to start organizing the knowledge, to put ideas together.

I think that Acme is very underrated in its domain (a tool for experts). The coverage is minuscule. That’s why I am thinking about blog posts, maybe video tutorials. I do not know what should it be exactly.
